items.prompt: Why is rescanning active price keys after every event an honest choice for n<=3000?

options.text: It makes the algorithm O(n log n) automatically.
options.why: Repeated linear scans can have quadratic total work.

options.text: Every update has constant work independent of active levels.
options.why: The extrema scan depends on how many keys are active.

options.text: The actual small input bound permits the stated O(n^2) design.
options.why: This is a bounded teaching choice, not a low-latency or unbounded-scale claim.

options.text: It proves a production matching engine can meet any latency limit.
options.why: No production workload or timing target is established by this source.

items.explanation: This is a bounded teaching choice, not a low-latency or unbounded-scale claim.
